answer.reason: Only JOS 10:1-5 tell of this king's own action, his rallying of the Amorite kings against Gibeon; the other marked verses concern the king of Ai or Jericho.

clauses.english: rallied four Amorite kings to attack Gibeon for making peace with Israel
clauses.quote: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon

doubts: JOS 8:1, 8:14, 8:23, 8:29 and 12:9 name the king of Ai or Jericho, not Adoni-zedek, so they were left out.
